fnol_text: My name is Kwame Ishikawa and I live at 621 Primrose Court, Ashland, OR 97575. You can reach me on (555) 521-5521 or kwame.ishikawa@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 17 September 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00131. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Ishikawa on (555) 521-5521 to acknowledge the claim. Kwame confirmed the loss date as 17 September 2026.
Site visit to 621 Primrose Court. Neighbour Jordan Wojcik was present and confirmed the timeline.
Kwame sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
